TestReadyBackupReclamation.test_expired_.note: Format 1 kept finished archives under in-memory download tokens and claimed free file names for them. Archives of runs that are not published are removed by the idle task.

TestBackupInventory.test_every_storage_c.note: Format 1 archived storage paths, so each StorageConfig path needed a class. A PostgreSQL archive holds the Library's content tables and the objects they name, so the classification is per table.

TestBackupInventory.test_non_path_fields.note: The PostgreSQL archive is defined by tables and columns, not StorageConfig fields.

TestBackupRoundTrip.test_sqlite_online_b.note: The PostgreSQL backup reads every table in one snapshot instead of SQLite's online backup API.

TestBackupRoundTrip.test_processing_incl.note: The legacy processing inbox directory is gone (#636); Processing items are rows and objects that round trip with the Library.

TestBackupRoundTrip.test_external_proces.obsolete: The legacy processing inbox directory is gone (#636); Processing items are rows and objects that round trip with the Library.

TestBackupRoundTrip.test_missing_referen.note: Stricter on PostgreSQL: a missing object fails the backup instead of producing an archive with a warning.

TestBackupRoundTrip.test_cancel_stops_ba.note: A PostgreSQL backup is a job; a run that stops before publishing leaves an unpublished archive the idle task removes.

TestBackupRoundTrip.test_orphan_annotati.note: PostgreSQL foreign keys make an orphan annotation unstorable; restore checks every reference of the staged rows.

TestBackupRoundTrip.test_work_identity_d.note: The SQLite compatibility mirror could drift from its Work rows; PostgreSQL has no mirror and checks the staged rows' keys.

TestRestoreRollback.test_fail_after_old_.note: Format 1 restored by renaming the SQLite database and the file directories under the root, recorded in a crash journal so each rename could be undone or finished. The PostgreSQL restore stages rows in a staging schema and replaces the Library in one database transaction (R4); objects are written once with put_new and never renamed over live ones, so there is no journal, rollback tree or rename window.

TestRestoreCrashWindows.test_crash_after.note: Format 1 restored by renaming the SQLite database and the file directories under the root, recorded in a crash journal so each rename could be undone or finished. The PostgreSQL restore stages rows in a staging schema and replaces the Library in one database transaction (R4); objects are written once with put_new and never renamed over live ones, so there is no journal, rollback tree or rename window. A crash before R4 commits leaves the old Library, after it the new one.
